answer: Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 53% independent neighbours on the funding graph. Because the relic calculation reruns each epoch, the falcon weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the velvet settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 42 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
